title: Chapter test: Structs
summary: Ten questions on defining structs, update syntax, Debug printing, methods and associated functions. You need 70% to pass; you can retry and your best score is kept.

questions.q: Why might you write `struct Celsius(f64);` instead of using `f64`?
options: So the compiler stops you passing a Fahrenheit value where Celsius is expected
questions.explanation: A newtype gives a value its own type, checked by the compiler, at no run-time cost.
